Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the supplied character concept board. Rework ONLY the FOLIO / 纸团, the first cream folded-paper creature in the reference. Preserve its asymmetrical two folded paper corner ears, four very short origami feet, overlapping envelope-like folds, face concealed inside the dark fold with small serious eyes (no pasted generic smile). Cream ivory paper fibers with warm tan crease shadows. A diligent slightly sensitive perfectionist.
Deliver a production game sprite sheet for this ONE character, keeping the rich cozy hand-painted pixel-art texture of the reference at small scale. Actual transparent RGBA background.
Layout: exactly THREE equal square columns and TWO equal square rows, overall aspect ratio 3:2 (1536x1024 ideal). Six separate full-body poses, one per cell. NO lines, labels, text, props outside cells, environment, floor, cast ground shadow, checkerboard, border, contact sheet title, or other characters.
Cell order reading left to right: top row IDLE, WORKING, THINKING; bottom row RESTING, ERROR, COMPLETED.
All six use the same camera (gentle three-quarter front view), identical character identity/material/detail, same overall design scale. Each cell has generous 10% transparent margins, creature horizontally centered, feet baseline at 86% of that cell height. No clipping or overlap between cells. Every cell is square. Keep props small within creature silhouette.
Pose instructions: idle: neutral alert standing; working: opens its envelope chest slightly while studying a small cream sheet; thinking: the two paper corner ears fold in slightly, intent eyes; resting: folds down into a low closed envelope with sleeping eyes hidden; error: one uneven crease and a tentative concerned eye, not a red symbol; completed: proudly pulls one neat small paper strip from its body.
Visual priorities: specific material texture, strong recognizable silhouette, four short feet, detailed but legible at 80px tall, warm atelier palette, no thick modern vector shapes, no generic geometric mascot, no oversized eyes. Do not include any part of the reference board or background. Return only this six-pose transparent sheet.
